title: SEBI Warning on Unregistered Advisory, Dabba Trading, and Guaranteed Return Schemes
source: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
content: SEBI issues strict public advisories warning investors against dealing with unregistered investment advisers, research analysts, or entities promising fixed or guaranteed returns in stock markets. Legitimate market intermediaries must possess a valid SEBI registration number. Off-market illegal trading (Dabba Trading) and collective investment schemes (CIS) operating without SEBI registration carry high financial risk and lack regulatory grievance protection.
